additional_kwargs.reasoning_content: We need count of failed runs per agent before Oct 28 2026. status maybe 'failed' or error not null. Assume status='failed'. Filter finished_at < '2026-10-28'. Join agents.

function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT a.name, COUNT(r.id) AS failed_count
FROM runs r
JOIN agents a ON r.agent_id = a.id
WHERE r.status = 'failed' AND r.finished_at < '2026-10-28'
GROUP BY a.name
ORDER BY failed_count DESC
LIMIT 1;"}
function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT a.name, COUNT(r.id) AS failed_count
FROM runs r
JOIN agents a ON r.agent_id = a.id
WHERE r.status = 'failed' AND r.finished_at < '2026-10-28'
GROUP BY a.name
ORDER BY failed_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
